_comment: Medium ships every image with an empty alt attribute. Images that have a caption are fine with alt="" — the rendered <figcaption> is their accessible description, and duplicating it in alt makes screen readers announce it twice. These are the images that have NO caption, and so would otherwise reach the page with no description at all. Keyed by public path; applied by scripts/import-medium.mjs so a rerun can't lose them.
/blog/hello-precious-world/01.jpg: The Earth seen from orbit, with the sun rising over the horizon and city lights spread across the night side of the planet.
